summary: AXIA Energia S.A., a Brazilian electric utility, filed a Form 6-K announcing that its NYSE-listed ADRs will cease trading after August 6, 2026 and migrate to the U.S. OTC market on August 7, 2026. The company will file Form 15F to deregister its securities and suspend reporting obligations under the Exchange Act, effective 90 days after filing. This is a voluntary delisting and deregistration following an April 1, 2026 material fact disclosure. No premium, price, or consideration is stated. The company will provide Rule 12g3-2(b) information on its IR website. Watch for the effective deregistration date and any shareholder reaction to the OTC migration.
